actions.description: Immediately close all open positions to prevent further losses
actions.verify: All positions closed, MT5 shows zero exposure

actions.description: Pause automated trading for the remainder of the day
actions.verify: Trading flag set to blocked, no new orders firing

actions.description: Alert risk management team with PnL summary
Review trade journal to identify loss drivers

rollback_steps.description: Risk officer manually clears trading block
